metadata.title: Quandles associated with group actions
metadata.abstract: A quandle is an algebraic system that can be regarded as a generalization of the conjugation operation in groups. In this paper, we establish a Cayley-type embedding theorem for finite quandles. To this end, we study a quandle construction associated with group actions and determine its fundamental structural properties. Applying the construction to the natural action of the symmetric group, we obtain a quandle into which every quandle of cardinality $n$ embeds.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 研究群作用关联的 quandle 构造，证明有限 quandle 的 Cayley 型嵌入定理，并用对称群的自然作用构造容纳给定大小 quandle 的对象。
analysis.breakthrough: 为有限 quandle 提供统一代数实现。
analysis.limitations: 摘要没有给出对结不变量或几何问题的直接新应用，嵌入范围和大小界应查正文。 数学解读仅依据官方摘要与作者评论，尚未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索与命中核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 工作以代数结构为中心，与本组曲率及度量空间研究直接联系较少，故后置。
